| After a battle at an interior site is initiated, use 1 Force to cause all leaders and all characters with ability &gt; 2 (on both sides) to be completely excluded from that battle. || {{Errata hl|1=If}} a battle {{Errata hl|1=was just initiated}} at an interior {{Errata hl|1=site,}} use 1 Force to {{Errata hl|1=exclude from that battle}} all characters {{Errata hl|1=of}} ability &gt; 2 {{Errata hl|1=and all leaders}} (on both {{Errata hl|1=sides).}} || If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force to exclude from that battle all characters of ability &gt; 2 and all leaders (on both sides). || If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 {{Errata hl|1=Force; for remainder of battle,}} all characters of ability &gt; 2 and all leaders (on both {{Errata hl|1=sides) are simultaneously excluded from that battle.}} || If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 {{Errata hl|1=Force to exclude from that battle}} all characters of ability &gt; 2 and all leaders (on both {{Errata hl|1=sides).}} || If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 {{Errata hl|1=Force; for remainder of battle,}} all characters of ability &gt; 2 and all leaders (on both {{Errata hl|1=sides) are simultaneously excluded from that battle.}} || If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force; for remainder of {{Errata hl|1=battle}} all characters of ability &gt; 2 and all leaders (on both sides) are simultaneously excluded from that battle.
